<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the elevation of the lower world through the service of offerings is connected to the ultimate purpose of creation—a dwelling place in the lower realms—achieved specifically through the descent from higher worlds, which instills a desire to return and be nullified to their source.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="2">that this matter</t>
    <t s="3">[the superiority in the matter of the elevation from lower to higher</t>
    <t s="4">(the nullification of yesh [existence] to ayin [nothingness])</t>
    <t s="5">that is in the service of the offerings]</t>
    <t s="6">is related to what is explained at the beginning of the discourse,</t>
    <t s="7">that the ultimate intention of the creation and coming-into-being of all the worlds is that through them there will be the coming-into-being of this lowest world,</t>
    <t s="8">and through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms will be completed.</t>
    <t s="9">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="10">that among the reasons for this, that the coming-into-being of this lowest world was in a manner that first the upper worlds came into being and specifically through them the coming-into-being of this lowest world was effected</t>
    <t s="11">(even though seemingly the coming-into-being of this lowest world should have been from the outset),</t>
    <t s="12">is,</t>
    <t s="13">that the matter of a dwelling place in the lower realms is that the lower ones</t>
    <t s="14">(the creations of this lowest world)</t>
    <t s="15">will be nullified to Elokus,</t>
    <t s="16">and this is effected through the coming-into-being of the lower ones being from the upper ones.</t>
    <t s="17">For through their comprehending that the vitality within them was initially included in the upper ones and afterwards descended below</t>
    <t s="18">(even to a descent that is incomparable),</t>
    <t s="19">there is effected within them the matter of ratzo [running] to be included in their source,</t>
    <t s="20">through which they are nullified of their existence.</t>
    <t s="21">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="22">that this matter is also hinted at in the principle that every descent is for the sake of an ascent.</t>
    <t s="23">For in addition to the interpretation that the intention of the descent is so that through it there will be an ascent to a level more elevated than the level before the descent,</t>
    <t s="24">one may add to this yet another interpretation,</t>
    <t s="25">that the intention in the descent</t>
    <t s="26">(and the hishtalshelus [chain-like descent])</t>
    <t s="27">of the worlds</t>
    <t s="28">[namely, in that the coming-into-being of this lowest world was in a manner that first the upper worlds came into being and descended from level to level</t>
    <t s="29">(from world to world)</t>
    <t s="30">until this lowest world came into being from them]</t>
    <t s="31">is so that there will be the matter of the ascent,</t>
    <t s="32">ratzo and elevation.</t>
    <t s="33">And likewise, regarding the Elokus light that brings the creations into existence,</t>
    <t s="34">that among the reasons for this, that initially the light was included in the luminary,</t>
    <t s="35">that this light is above any relation to worlds</t>
    <t s="36">[as is known, that in the Ein Sof before the tzimtzum</t>
    <t s="37">(the light before the tzimtzum is</t>
    <t s="38">(generally speaking)</t>
    <t s="39">light included in the luminary)</t>
    <t s="40">there was no place for worlds],</t>
    <t s="41">and through the tzimtzum</t>
    <t s="42">(a tzimtzum of the manner of removal)</t>
    <t s="43">there was drawn from Him</t>
    <t s="44">(from the Ein Sof before the tzimtzum)</t>
    <t s="45">the light of the kav [line] that has a relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="46">and afterwards there were yet many tzimtzumim</t>
    <t s="47">(descents)</t>
    <t s="48">in the light until it became a source to bring the creations into existence</t>
    <t s="49">(even though seemingly the drawing down of this light should have been from the outset),</t>
    <t s="50">is,</t>
    <t s="51">so that in the creations there will be the ratzo and ascent to be included in the light that is above relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="52">and through this they will be nullified to Elokus with ultimate nullification,</t>
    <t s="53">nullification of existence.</t>
    <t s="54">[As is known,</t>
    <t s="55">that the nullification that comes from the revelation of light commensurate with the worlds,</t>
    <t s="56">is only nullification of yesh,</t>
    <t s="57">and the true matter of nullification,</t>
    <t s="58">nullification of existence,</t>
    <t s="59">is specifically from the light that is above relation to worlds].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the unique phrase "a satisfying aroma" said regarding offerings refers to the pleasure from the nullification of yesh to ayin, which is the primary aspect of the service of offerings, as explained by the Alter Rebbe through the concept that before creation He and His Name alone existed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter in more detail,</t>
    <t s="2">will be understood by prefacing what is said regarding offerings,</t>
    <t s="3">"a satisfying aroma," and Chazal explained,</t>
    <t s="4">"It is a satisfaction before Me that I spoke and My will was done."</t>
    <t s="5">And it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="6">behold, this "I spoke and My will was done" applies to all the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="7">and nevertheless it is said specifically regarding offerings.</t>
    <t s="8">And the Alter Rebbe explains,</t>
    <t s="9">by prefacing what Chazal said,</t>
    <t s="10">"Before the world was created, He and His Name alone existed."</t>
    <t s="11">That "His Name" is the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="12">which is the source of the influence and vitality of the creations,</t>
    <t s="13">and "His Name" that existed before the world was created is the aspect of Malchus as it was included in Ein Sof Baruch Hu,</t>
    <t s="14">for when it is there it is not in a state of existence,</t>
    <t s="15">like light included in the luminary, which is not in existence.</t>
    <t s="16">And afterwards there was the spreading forth of the light and radiance to give life</t>
    <t s="17">to the creations from ayin to yesh.</t>
    <t s="18">And he explains,</t>
    <t s="19">that this, that the light descended from its level</t>
    <t s="20">(as it was included in Ein Sof)</t>
    <t s="21">to give life to the creations from ayin to yesh,</t>
    <t s="22">is for the sake of an ascent,</t>
    <t s="23">so that there will be from yesh to ayin,</t>
    <t s="24">namely,</t>
    <t s="25">that the yesh will be nullified and included in the actual light of Ein Sof Baruch Hu.</t>
    <t s="26">And based on this he explains that regarding offerings</t>
    <t s="27">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="28">it is said "a satisfying aroma"</t>
    <t s="29">(satisfying [nichoach] from the term nachas ruach [satisfaction]),</t>
    <t s="30">because the primary satisfaction and delight above is from this, that the yesh is nullified and becomes the aspect of ayin,</t>
    <t s="31">and the primary nullification of yesh to ayin is in the action of the offerings.</t>
    <t s="32">For the matter of offerings is an elevation from lower to higher,</t>
    <t s="33">that the lower one goes out and is nullified of its existence and ascends</t>
    <t s="34">(is included)</t>
    <t s="35">above</t>
    <t s="36">(as will be explained below).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section adds that through the offering, not only the animal itself is elevated, but also the supernal angels are elevated, as they are nourished by the offering and thereby nullified into the Ein Sof, and this is the concept of the song during the offerings.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to add,</t>
    <t s="1">in addition to the elevation of the offering itself,</t>
    <t s="2">that the animal that was offered upon the altar was burned</t>
    <t s="3">(nullified of its existence)</t>
    <t s="4">and included in the supernal fire,</t>
    <t s="5">through this an elevation was also effected in the supernal angels.</t>
    <t s="6">As it is written,</t>
    <t s="7">"My offering, My bread for My fires,"</t>
    <t s="8">"My fires" are the seraphim,</t>
    <t s="9">and the offering is the bread and sustenance for them,</t>
    <t s="10">which adds in them strength and vitality to be nullified and included in Ein Sof, even to the point of being absorbed</t>
    <t s="11">in the body of the King.</t>
    <t s="12">And this is the concept of the song that was at the time of the offering of the offerings,</t>
    <t s="13">for every ascent is through song.</t>
    <t s="14">As Chazal said,</t>
    <t s="15">"All the masters of song go out in song and are drawn in song,"</t>
    <t s="16">and it is brought in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="17">in the name of the Sefer Likkutei Amarim of the holy Maggid,</t>
    <t s="18">that "the masters of song" are the angels</t>
    <t s="19">[And one may connect this with the interpretation</t>
    <t s="20">(simply)</t>
    <t s="21">that "masters of song" are animals that give song from their necks,</t>
    <t s="22">for also the angels are called "animals" and "beasts"],</t>
    <t s="23">and the meaning of "they go out in song" is,</t>
    <t s="24">that through the song that the angels say, they go out from their vessels,</t>
    <t s="25">to be included in Ein Sof Baruch Hu.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
